problem.title: Where did the paycheck go?
problem.description: A coffee here, forgotten subscriptions, a convenience store run there, those 'Interest-Free' payments stacking up... Families in Mexico lose 15% to 30% of their income to invisible leaks. For some that's $4,000; for others, over $15,000 MXN a month. It’s not about how much you earn, but how much you keep.
problem.investmentKick: Nestera is not an expense, it's the tool that plugs these leaks and pays for its own subscription from the very first month.

solution.title: It's not another boring spreadsheet.
solution.subtitle: Spreadsheets demand work. Nestera gives answers. We connect your accounts, detect patterns, and tell you: 'Hey, you reduced your food delivery spending by 10% this week—nice!' It's like having a financial advisor in your pocket 24/7.

encryption.title: Digital Armor
encryption.description: We use AES-256 encryption (the same standard as your bank). Your info travels in 'digital vaults' that only you can open.

privacy.description: Nestera is a 'black box' to us. We do not sell your data, we do not share it, and our engineers cannot see your transactions.
